title: Hasbro The Legend of Zelda Heroes of Hyrule Ganondorf | The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Deluxe Collectible 6-Inch Action Figure
features: THE LEGEND OF ZELDA: TEARS OF THE KINGDOM: This officially licensed Ganondorf action figure is inspired by the action-adventure video game -- a great gift for collectors and fans ages 4 and up
PREMIUM DESIGN AND ARTICULATION: Fans can display this Legend of Zelda figure with game-inspired sculpt and design and 20+ articulation points, in their collections
CHARACTER-INSPIRED ACCESSORIES: Pose out the iconic villain -- coming in at over 7.5 inches within a 6-inch scale -- with the included Gloom Sword, scabbard, and interchangeable right hand
WINDOW BOX PACKAGING: Display Legend of Zelda fandom on your shelf with window box packaging featuring game-inspired character art
BUILD OUT YOUR HEROES OF HYRULE COLLECTION: Look for more The Legend of Zelda action figures to build a sprawling kingdom of collectibles on your shelf (Each sold separately. Subject to availability)
EVIL ARISES: Awakened from his prison under Hyrule Castle, the powerful Demon King Ganondorf spreads his evil across the land once more
